In a large bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar. Mix until smooth and well combined. Do not cream. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix until fully incorporated. 3. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking tray for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. If desired, sprinkle with flaky sea salt and let cool for about 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy! ‼️Du hast Sonnencreme dein ganzes Leben lang falsch benutzt! 😳☀️  Viele denken: „Ich habe Sonnencreme drauf, also kann mir nichts passieren.“ Aber so einfach ist es leider nicht. Jede Haut hat eine sogenannte Eigenschutzzeit. Das ist die Zeit, die deine Haut ungeschützt in der Sonne verbringen kann, bevor ein Sonnenbrand entsteht. Bei sehr heller Haut können das oft nur 5–10 Minuten sein, bei dunkleren Hauttypen etwas länger. Der Lichtschutzfaktor (LSF) gibt an, um wie viel diese Eigenschutzzeit theoretisch verlängert wird. Beispiel: Eigenschutzzeit 10 Minuten LSF 30 10 × 30 = 300 Minuten theoretischer Schutz Aber jetzt kommt der wichtige Haken: Diese Berechnung stammt aus Laborbedingungen. Im echten Leben schwitzen wir, gehen ins Wasser, trocknen uns ab, tragen Kleidung oder cremen viel zu wenig Sonnencreme auf. Die meisten Menschen verwenden nur etwa ein Viertel bis die Hälfte der empfohlenen Menge. Dadurch wird der tatsächliche Schutz oft deutlich geringer als auf der Verpackung angegeben. ‼️Wichtig übrigens:  Nachcremen verlängert deine maximale Sonnenzeit nicht unbegrenzt. Es sorgt lediglich dafür, dass der ursprünglich vorhandene Schutz möglichst erhalten bleibt. Sonnencreme ist außerdem kein Freifahrtschein für stundenlanges Sonnenbaden. Schatten, Kleidung, Sonnenbrille und das Meiden der Mittagssonne bleiben wichtige Bestandteile des Sonnenschutzes. 💡Fun Fact: Für den gesamten Körper eines Erwachsenen werden ungefähr 30–40 ml Sonnencreme benötigt, das entspricht etwa sechs gehäuften Teelöffeln oder einem kleinen Schnapsglas voll. Die meisten Menschen verwenden deutlich weniger. ✨Schick dieses Reel an jemanden, der denkt, mit Sonnencreme wäre man unbesiegbar. ➡️Welchen LSF nutzt du, wenn du Raus in die Sonne gehst? Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍫💌🍓 So fudgy & perfect for valentines!  (Recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients: 10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips/ chunks 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top and drizzle)  *if the nutella is too thick to drizzle you can melt it slightly in the microwave Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 20-30 minutes. Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C) and line/grease an 8x8-inch pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes to help create a crackly top. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips/chopped chocolate. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add the strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!   #bakingrecipe #fudgybrownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #Recipe

Pt.4 | My fall bakery menu 🍂 Recipe below 👇🏼  Crumbl released their Dubai Chocolate Brownie, but why buy it when you can make an even better one at home? 🤎✨ Ingredients 🟤Brownie Base * 180g caster sugar * 2 eggs * 113g unsalted butter (for browning) * 170g chopped chocolate * 80g plain flour * 3 tbsp cocoa powder * ½ tsp salt 💚Kunafa Filling * 260g kunafa pastry (finely chopped) * 2 tbsp unsalted butter (for toasting kunafa) * 320g pistachio cream 🍫Chocolate Ganache * 120g double cream * 100g milk chocolate (chopped) Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #Recipe #fall
